participant\u000BA
A -> B

A\u000B->\u000BB
=== nbsp participant (escaped)
participant A
A -> B
=== nbsp arrow (escaped)
A -> B : x
=== line separator in label (escaped)
A -> B : one two
=== next line in label (escaped)
A -> B : one\u0085two
=== form feed (escaped)
participant\u000CA
A -> B
=== tab separated
participant	A
A	->	B	:	tab
=== kelvin (escaped)
participant K
